verdict.rationale: Scaffolding and configuration are well documented. The create-dagster CLI scaffolds projects (`uvx create-dagster@latest project`), `dg scaffold defs` generates component definitions with `defs.yaml`, and an official dg CLI, a dagster-expert AI skill for coding agents, and llms.txt support agent-driven setup. Headless execution is only thinly evidenced: dbt docs mention running via 'UI or APIs', the Dagster+ MCP server can 'take actions', and `dg dev` launches a webserver, but no CLI run/launch command is documented and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: a documented headless CLI/API command to execute a pipeline end-to-end, an API reference/spec for triggering runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running a full pipeline without the UI.
